name: Entity Definition Update
description: Developer service to apply pending entity-type/field storage definition (schema) updates from regular hook_update_N()/hook_install() code.
project_description: Entity Definition Update provides a single developer-facing service that applies pending entity-type and field storage definition (schema) changes to the database, intended to be called from a module's own hook_install() or hook_update_N() implementations. It is an alternative to relying on Drupal core's Entity Definition Update Manager, which no longer applies definition updates automatically. The service (entity_definition_update.entity_definition_update_manager, class Drupal\entity_definition_update\EntityDefinitionUpdateManager) exposes applyUpdates(), which reads core's complete change list, clears cached entity type and field definitions when changes exist, then applies entity-type creates/updates and field storage definition creates/updates/deletes through core's entity type listener and field storage definition listener. Updates that would require an entity data migration are rejected with an exception, so developers back up and restore data themselves as part of the update hook. The module ships no routes, forms, permissions, config, or Drush commands; it is used purely from update/deployment code that runs via drush updatedb or update.php. Depends on core System and Field.
